candidates.explanation: The refresh token is signed with expiresIn read from 'auth.expires' (the short access-token lifetime) instead of 'auth.refreshExpires' (AUTH_REFRESH_TOKEN_EXPIRES_IN). Refresh tokens therefore expire minutes after iat, and /auth/refresh returns 401 once the access-token lifetime has passed.

fix.description: Use the refreshExpires config value when signing the refresh token.
